lines.text: {"op":"add","path":"/root","value":"privacy-page"}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/privacy-page","value":{"type":"Stack","props":{"direction":"vertical","gap":"lg","className":"mx-auto w-full max-w-3xl px-6 py-10"},"children":["page-header","privacy-settings","download-card","privacy-note"]}}
{"op":"add","path":"/elements/page-header","value":{"type":"Stack","props":{"direction":"vertical","gap":"sm"},"children":["eyebrow","page-title","page-description","autosave-badge"]}}
{"op":"add","path":"/elements/eyebrow","value":{"type":"Text","props":{"text":"ACCOUNT SETTINGS","variant":"caption"},"children":[]}}
{"op":"add","path":"/elements/page-title","value":{"type":"Heading","props":{"text":"Your privacy, your choice","level":"h1"},"children":[]}}
{"op":"add","path":"/elements/page-description","value":{"type":"Text","props":{"text":"Choose who can find you, reach you, and use your information.","variant":"lead"},"children":[]}}
{"op":"add","path":"/elements/autosave-badge","value":{"type":"Badge","props":{"text":"Changes apply automatically","variant":"secondary"},"children":[]}}
{"op":"add","path":"/elements/privacy-settings","value":{"type":"Grid","props":{"columns":1,"gap":"lg"},"children":["visibility-card","messages-card","sharing-card"]}}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/visibility-card","value":{"type":"Card","props":{"title":"Profile visibility","description":"Control who can see your posts, photos, and full profile."},"children":["visibility-options","visibility-note"]}}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/visibility-options","value":{"type":"Radio","props":{"label":"Who can see my profile","name":"profileVisibility","options":["Everyone","Followers","Only me"],"value":{"$bindState":"/profileVisibility"},"checks":[{"type":"required","message":"Choose who can see your profile."}]},"children":[]}}
{"op":"add","path":"/state/profileVisibility","value":"Followers"}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/visibility-note","value":{"type":"Text","props":{"text":"Your display name and profile photo remain visible so people can recognize you.","variant":"muted"},"children":[]}}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/messages-card","value":{"type":"Card","props":{"title":"Messages","description":"Decide who can start a new conversation with you."},"children":["message-options","messages-note"]}}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/message-options","value":{"type":"Select","props":{"label":"Who can message me","name":"messageAudience","options":["Everyone","People I follow","No one"],"value":{"$bindState":"/messageAudience"},"checks":[{"type":"required","message":"Choose who can message you."}]},"children":[]}}
{"op":"add","path":"/state/messageAudience","value":"People I follow"}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/messages-note","value":{"type":"Text","props":{"text":"Existing conversations stay open. You can block someone from their profile at any time.","variant":"muted"},"children":[]}}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/sharing-card","value":{"type":"Card","props":{"title":"Partner data sharing","description":"Choose whether partners can use your activity for personalized advertising."},"children":["sharing-toggle","sharing-note"]}}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/sharing-toggle","value":{"type":"Switch","props":{"label":"Share activity data with advertising partners","name":"partnerSharing","checked":{"$bindState":"/partnerSharing"}},"children":[]}}
{"op":"add","path":"/state/partnerSharing","value":false}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/sharing-note","value":{"type":"Text","props":{"text":"Optional. Turning this off stops future sharing for ad personalization. You’ll still see ads, and it won’t affect your account access.","variant":"muted"},"children":[]}}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/download-card","value":{"type":"Card","props":{"title":"Download your data","description":"Get a copy of your profile, posts, photos, messages, and account activity."},"children":["download-details","download-button","download-dialog"]}}
{"op":"add","path":"/elements/download-details","value":{"type":"Text","props":{"text":"Choose a file format and review what your archive will include.","variant":"muted"},"children":[]}}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/download-button","value":{"type":"Button","props":{"label":"Download my data","variant":"secondary"},"on":{"press":{"action":"setState","params":{"statePath":"/downloadOpen","value":true}}},"children":[]}}
{"op":"add","path":"/state/downloadOpen","value":false}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/download-dialog","value":{"type":"Dialog","props":{"title":"Your data archive","description":"Choose how you’d like to receive a copy of your information.","openPath":"/downloadOpen"},"children":["export-format","export-sensitive-note","export-preview-note","close-download"]}}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/export-format","value":{"type":"Radio","props":{"label":"Archive format","name":"exportFormat","options":["HTML — easy to browse","JSON — machine readable"],"value":{"$bindState":"/exportFormat"},"checks":[{"type":"required","message":"Choose an archive format."}]},"children":[]}}
{"op":"add","path":"/state/exportFormat","value":"HTML — easy to browse"}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/export-sensitive-note","value":{"type":"Alert","props":{"title":"Keep your archive private","message":"Your archive includes personal information and private messages. Store it somewhere secure.","type":"info"},"children":[]}}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/export-preview-note","value":{"type":"Text","props":{"text":"This preview doesn’t connect to an account. Downloading an archive will be available when the app’s data export service is connected.","variant":"muted"},"children":[]}}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/close-download","value":{"type":"Button","props":{"label":"Done","variant":"secondary"},"on":{"press":{"action":"setState","params":{"statePath":"/downloadOpen","value":false}}},"children":[]}}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/privacy-note","value":{"type":"Text","props":{"text":"Preview: settings update within this page. Connect your account service to save them permanently.","variant":"caption"},"children":[]}}
